patch_description:
This edit targets the main failure mode: the model is learning medium/long-horizon patterns that disappear in the validation regime. I’m switching the feature set toward shorter, regime-invariant signals and explicit rate-of-change features:

- add rolling z-score normalization on price returns, volume, and volatility using only past data
- emphasize short lookbacks (5–20 bars) instead of relying heavily on 60-bar constructs
- add trend-of-regime features such as volatility trend, efficiency trend, and autocorrelation trend
- add one compact interaction: short momentum × volatility regime
- slightly regularize XGBoost and reduce tree count to encourage robust, high-sample patterns

This should help the model keep predictive slope in later regimes while also reducing the train→val collapse in slope and prediction standard deviation.
